saga: Y1 Steward Wilfred the Steady: “The granary counts 40 measures — a season, no more. Plant a farm on open plains.”
Y1 Steward Wilfred the Steady: “Every wall and roof to come is standing in that forest. A lumber camp — near the trees, while they last.”
Y1 The raiders have set up camp in the wilds — Crowsfoot. For now, it is only a nest of brigands.
Y2 Steward Wilfred the Steady: “When they mass at the tents, you have time yet. When the camp stirs — you do not.”
Y2 Steward Wilfred the Steady: “The ground there is spent, and the camp struck itself — the timbers are already home. The land lies open for the plough now. Follow the forest.”
Y2 Steward Wilfred the Steady: “You have swords enough to answer the warlord at the tents, sire — if you dare leave home thin.”
Y2 The war-camp stirs — Crowsfoot may march soon.

Y3 The lumber camp at the spent ground is struck — its timbers come home.

Y6 Steward Wilfred the Steady: “Warlord Grim Skullring has claimed the nest. His raids will march from there — you can watch that road now.”
